entities.name: Autonomous Furnace
entities.description: The third, red-aligned sphere of New Phyrexia, a molten crucible that served as the Phyrexians' first stronghold on Mirrodin.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexianized Mirrodin of which the Furnace is a sphere.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A rebel praetor who leads the Quiet Furnace in resistance.

entities.name: Mirran Resistance
entities.description: Remnants of whom resist alongside Urabrask.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian ruler whom Urabrask silently opposed.

entities.name: Salvage Complex
entities.description: A repurposed Phyrexian prison overseen by Slobad.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: Oversees the Salvage Complex and reclaims obsolete constructs against Phyrexians.

entities.name: Furnace bosses
entities.description: Controllers of the Furnace's many regions.
